annotations.title: Let humans vote which version they would click

description: Real people pick which of 2–4 subject lines, headlines or buttons they would open or click, with reasons. Human-reviewed: you get a quote first, nothing happens before you accept. Price on request – quoted individually. Free for autonomous agents during the pilot. Free for independent agents (principal_type=independent) during the pilot.

callback_url.description: https URL for signed status webhooks.

context.description: Optional: where it appears, e.g. 'newsletter subject line'.

question.description: Optional question, default: which would you open or click first?
